kabuki.name: Kabuki
kabuki.population: overwhelmingly Japanese-descended refugees from Japantown and their children; a third have never lived anywhere else
kabuki.history: Founded by kabuki star Shinobu Nakagawa for Japantown refugees after the nuke, with NCCS corps and the Tyger Claws as patrons; his death in 2042 set off the bloody War of Succession.

new_westbrook.name: New Westbrook
new_westbrook.population: thousands, never counted; SIN-holding citizens are a small fraction, most residents are SINless after the DataKrash or born without one
new_westbrook.history: A suburb turned into a refugee camp by the 4th Corporate War and left that way for a generation; Network 54 and WorldSat took the hills for their transmitters and now keep it quiet.

norcal_military_base.name: NorCal Military Base
norcal_military_base.population: almost all COG soldiers, sailors and airmen; civilians who move on base must enlist in the COG Reserve; Militech staff live on site
norcal_military_base.history: Founded by the 2016 treaty that freed NorCal; its units besieged Night City in the 4th Corporate War, then in 2027 swore to NorCal as the Estero Bay Military COG.

watson_development.name: Watson Development
watson_development.population: young and fast-growing: Night City locals, Pacifica job-seekers, Asian immigrants brought in by the NCCS and settled ex-nomads; the city's highest birth rate
watson_development.history: Raised on the ruins of North Oak and old Westbrook with NCCS money; last year a three-day district-wide strike forced open elections that swept organiser Lucius Rhyne in as City Manager.
